01-02　视频指令遵循 · 原表标签「时间戳偏差—P1」

寿司广告的三次切点

考点三个镜头是否按指定时刻切换？观察方法按顺序记下刀切鱼柳、手捏寿司、黑盘成品首次入镜的三个时间，再逐一核对。工序都拍到了，切点仍可能提早。

正例目标

3 秒切到刀切鱼柳，7 秒切到手捏寿司，12 秒切到黑盘成品。

896 × 512 · 362 帧 · 15.11 秒 · 2 声道 · 单独播放
查看原始 prompt 与最终 PE
原始 prompt
15秒电影感日料广告。深色木质料理台，左上方暖光，浅景深，舒缓纯音乐。0–3秒俯拍整条带冰三文鱼，白衣厨师扶住鱼头尾；3–7秒切极近微距，厨刀切入橙红鱼柳；7–12秒切近景，厨师给饭团覆鱼片、按压，用银镊点上绿叶；12–15秒切成品展示。 最后一镜中，成品在哑光黑盘正中，日文书法「一期一会、極上の味」从左到右写出，墨色渐浓，末笔落定微光定格。
最终 PE
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, in an overhead high-angle shot, the camera pushes in at slow speed toward a whole, fresh salmon resting atop a bed of crushed glistening ice on a dark oiled wood counter. A middle-aged male chef wearing a crisp white cotton sushi uniform stands behind the counter, his bare hands carefully holding and stabilizing the fish by its silver-scaled head on the left and tapered tail on the right. Warm directional key light spills from the upper-left corner, highlighting melting water droplets and iridescent scales against the rich shadowed wood, creating a shallow depth of field. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to an extreme macro shot as the camera pans right at slow speed, tracking the blade of a polished single-bevel yanagiba knife slicing cleanly through a thick, vibrant orange-red salmon fillet on a dark wooden cutting board. The razor-sharp edge glides through the flesh at a low diagonal angle, parting the distinct white intramuscular fat striations with smooth precision, revealing glistening moisture across the cut surface under the warm upper-left rim light. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up from an eye-level angle holding a static shot of the chef's hands crafting a piece of nigiri. His deft fingers gently drape the sliced salmon fillet over an oval mound of vinegared sushi rice, executing a precise two-stroke press to mold the sushi firmly. He then lifts a pair of slender silver culinary tweezers and delicately sets a single fresh microgreen leaf onto the center of the fish, his hands moving with practiced rhythm against the out-of-focus dark wooden interior. [Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to a close-up slightly high-angle shot as the camera pushes in at slow speed toward the finished salmon nigiri positioned squarely in the center of a circular matte black ceramic plate. Traditional Japanese calligraphy appears on screen, writing from left to right across the upper half of the frame in flowing sumi ink strokes to form "一期一会、極上の味", the ink density deepening from a soft wash to dense charcoal black, culminating in a subtle glint across the final brushstroke before settling into a pristine freeze-frame.
overall_soundscape: The delicate crunch and rustle of crushed ice shifting under the fish is clearly heard in the room tone, followed by the crisp, pronounced hiss and glide of the chef's knife parting the tender salmon fillet. Soft, audible finger presses against the moist rice grains accompany the assembly, punctuated by a distinct metallic click of tweezers setting the garnish. A muted, resonant ceramic tap concludes the sequence as the plate settles on the counter, accompanied by a quiet, warm interior kitchen ambience.
non_diegetic_music: A slow-tempo acoustic score featuring gentle solo piano chords intertwined with sustained, resonant koto plucks and a quiet, low-register cello pad underneath. The arrangement maintains a consistent, understated dynamic without crescendo, tapering to a sustained single note at the final rest.

谁进了我的客厅

考点开场有没有完整拍到屋主进门？观察方法只回放第一镜，从屋主第一次露面看到客厅出现。找出她的手碰门、推开门和身体跨过门槛的连续动作。

正例目标

屋主在门外伸手推门，随后跨过门槛进屋。

896 × 512 · 362 帧 · 15.11 秒 · 2 声道 · 单独播放
查看原始 prompt 与最终 PE
原始 prompt
现实都市剧。开场屋主站在关着的门外，伸手推开门，从门外跨入客厅，镜头跟过门槛。 中景越过屋主肩膀，看见另一名女子正在沙发上吃水果。屋主愣住，用急切女声问：“你是谁？怎么在我家？”沙发上的女子翘起二郎腿，语带轻蔑：“你前夫把这房子给我了，从今天起，这儿归我。”近景，屋主变脸快步上前：“这房子写的是我名字，滚出去！”对方愣一下起身：“你叫谁滚呢？这就是我的房子！”屋主掏出手机冷笑：“行，那我报警，让警察告诉你这房子到底归谁！”
最终 PE

She grasps the metallic handle, pushes the heavy door open, and steps across the threshold into the entryway of a modern, stylish apartment illuminated by recessed warm ceiling spotlights, revealing polished tile flooring and an open living room beyond. [Shot 2] At 00:02.700, the camera cuts to an over-the-shoulder medium shot looking past the homeowner's right shoulder, performing a slow push in toward the spacious living room. In the midground, lounging upon an L-shaped grey fabric sofa, sits a woman in her mid-twenties with wavy chestnut-dyed hair, dramatic makeup, and a fitted emerald-green knit dress, spearing a piece of honeydew melon with a small silver fork from a crystal bowl on the white marble coffee table. The homeowner, an on-screen adult female speaker with an urgent, alarmed voice (S1), stiffens in place and demands anxiously, <d>[Chinese] 你是谁？怎么在我家？</d> The lounging intruder, an on-screen female speaker with an arrogant, dismissive tone (S2), crosses one leg over the other, rests her elbow on the sofa cushion, and retorts with a mocking half-smile, <d>[Chinese] 你前夫把这房子给我了，从今天起，这儿归我。</d> [Shot 3] At 00:07.400, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of the homeowner (S1) as the camera holds a static shot. Her facial expression tightens with rage as she knits her brows, swiftly taking two aggressive steps forward into the living room while pointing an accusatory finger forward, shouting forcefully, <d>[Chinese] 这房子写的是我名字，滚出去！</d> [Shot 4] At 00:10.100, the camera cuts to a medium shot of the woman in the green dress (S2) beside the coffee table, executing a tilt up as she momentarily blinks in surprise, then quickly flares her nostrils in anger and abruptly stands up from the cushions to face her rival, yelling back aggressively, <d>[Chinese] 你叫谁滚呢？这就是我的房子！</d> [Shot 5] At 00:12.300, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of the homeowner (S1) as the camera pushes in slightly. She lets out a cold, dismissive sneer, thrusts her hand into her trench coat pocket, and retrieves a sleek black smartphone, tapping the glass screen with her manicured thumb as she declares with icy firmness, <d>[Chinese] 行，那我报警，让警察告诉你这房子到底归谁！</d>
overall_soundscape: A distinct metallic click of the door latch turning followed by the pronounced creak of the wooden apartment door swinging inward, immediately accompanied by loud high-heeled shoe clacks tapping across the polished marble floor. A faint clink of the silver fork scraping against the crystal glass fruit bowl is clearly heard from the sofa, followed by the audible rustle of knit fabric as legs cross. The tense verbal exchange is punctuated by the sudden dull thud and rustle of sofa cushions as the intruder pushes herself upward, ending with the crisp friction sound of the smartphone sliding out of a wool coat pocket and a firm screen tap.

01-04　视频指令遵循 · 原表标签「景别错误」

冰淇淋广告开场景别

考点第一镜是否用了指定的特写？观察方法暂停在开场第一幅清楚画面，看脸和蛋筒占多大面积。后面洒糖时的微距镜头另计。

开场抽查　在第 0、0.5、1.25 秒，正例都能看见女子上半身和身后的柜台，“脸和蛋筒占满画面”只部分体现。反例拍到人物全身、窗户和整排展柜，两条的景别差异清楚。

正例目标

脸和手里的蛋筒占满开场画面。

896 × 512 · 362 帧 · 15.11 秒 · 2 声道 · 单独播放
查看原始 prompt 与最终 PE
原始 prompt
一位深色及肩发、自然淡妆的年轻女子担任全片主角，外观连续。创建一个超写实的高级冰淇淋广告，呈现奢华夏日生活美学。场景设在一家优雅的手工冰淇淋店内，大理石柜台、柔和的室内装饰、玻璃展示柜、温暖的阳光、柔和的散景、电影级调色、真实的反射和高级商业灯光。自然过渡到黄金时刻的迷人欧式街道，两旁是咖啡馆和鲜花。
广告以电影级特写开场，脸部与手中蛋筒占满画面，她对着镜头温暖微笑，手持一个装满草莓和香草冰淇淋的华夫筒。她慢慢旋转蛋筒，展示其奶油质地和多彩配料。
过渡到极致的微距镜头，彩虹糖粒轻轻洒在冰淇淋上，随后是浓郁闪亮的巧克力酱倾泻而下。捕捉奢华的冰淇淋融化特写、松脆配料、新鲜草莓片和华夫筒的细腻纹理。
她将蛋筒缓缓举到唇边，享受一口，然后自然微笑，品尝奶油风味。相机以电影级细节捕捉她真实的表情和融化的冰淇淋。
场景转换到户外，她漫步在迷人的欧式街道上，手持冰淇淋，温暖的阳光洒在她的脸上。她回头自信地微笑，继续走过咖啡馆和鲜花点缀的人行道，发丝在微风中轻轻飘动。
广告在冰淇淋店外优雅的主镜头中结束。她将冰淇淋举到脸旁，与镜头保持眼神交流，微笑着用温柔的普通话女声说道：“这是我最喜欢的一家冰激凌，每一口都让生活更甜蜜。”相机缓缓推进，突出奢华的冰淇淋和她容光焕发的表情，然后淡出。
最终 PE

Bright studio rim lights glisten across the reflective chocolate drizzle and glistening micro-droplets of melting cream as a few crisp waffle crumbs cling to the cone's diamond-patterned rim. Standing gracefully center-frame, the young female on-screen protagonist with a gentle, soothing voice (S1) holds the artisanal waffle cone elegantly beside her cheek, maintains direct eye contact with the lens, and smiles warmly as she speaks softly, <d>[Chinese] 这是我最喜欢的一家冰激凌，每一口都让生活更甜蜜。</d> The camera glides closer, accentuating her glowing complexion and the luxurious dessert before the image softly fades out.

生成一段温暖明亮的布偶猫爬架广告，所有画外音为同一位温柔的日语女声，每句同步显示相同的日语字幕。镜头一贴近木地板快速向前，扫地机器人穿过客厅，旁白「毎日、この小さな世界をパトロールするのが私の日課。」镜头二仰拍布偶猫抬头，视线牵出墙上原木色猫爬架，旁白「でも、一番気になるのは…あの上。」镜头三跟拍猫跃上踏板、沿剑麻柱攀爬，旁白「一歩、また一歩。木の温もりを感じながら。」镜头四从下方特写透明亚克力太空舱，猫蜷成一团，肉垫与蓬松肚皮轻压透明底，旁白「ふわふわ、ぽかぽか。ここが私の特等席。」镜头五拉远定格：它在高处俯视客厅，右侧出现原木色手写英文“Their Own Little Universe.”，旁白「見守っててね、私たちの小さな宇宙から。」
只在第一镜开头可见墙面的1秒，以及最后一镜拉远时露出的米白墙面上，出现数块醒目的墨黑色不规则斑点，边缘发脏，位置避开爬架、墙饰及真实投影。中间三镜的墙面干净，猫、家具、字幕与声音连续。

原始 prompt

原始 prompt

固定双人中景，两位成年人在空旷站台面对面，衣服和手中的物件清楚可见。穿蓝外套拿车票的人站画面左侧，戴红围巾拿书的人站右侧。广播响起，两人互相点头，始终处于同一镜头。
最终 PE
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, in a static medium two-shot framed at eye level, two adults stand facing each other across the center of an expansive, open-air train station platform under an overcast slate-gray sky. On the left side of the frame, an adult male in his early thirties with trimmed dark hair and a calm expression wears a structured navy-blue wool pea coat over charcoal trousers, holding a printed rectangular train ticket between his gloved right fingers at waist height. On the right side, facing him in profile, an adult female in her late twenties with her dark hair gathered beneath a voluminous crimson knitted wool scarf wears a tailored beige trench coat, holding a thick hardcover book bound in dark green cloth with both hands at chest level. The concrete platform stretches behind them with yellow textured tactile paving strips along the platform edge, illuminated by cold overhead fluorescent tubes suspended from industrial iron girders and distant amber platform signals glowing softly in the misty distance. As an automated chime chimes from an unseen public address speaker above, the man in the blue coat slightly lowers his gaze to the paper ticket before raising his eyes back to her face. In response, the woman in the red scarf offers a gentle, reassuring nod with a subtle softening around her eyes, shifting her grip slightly on the hardcover book. The man returns the deliberate nod with a slight dip of his head and shoulders, standing grounded as a chilly draft lightly flutters the corner of the paper ticket and rustles the fringed edge of her wool scarf while both maintain steady eye contact.
overall_soundscape: A hollow, low-frequency wind whistles continuously across the vacant concrete platform, accompanied by the distant mechanical hum of idle rail equipment. A distinct two-tone electronic chime chimes overhead, followed by an audible, reverberant public address voice echoing throughout the station structure. In the foreground, the faint rustle of the paper ticket shifting in gloved fingers and the soft friction of heavy wool fabric are clearly heard against the ambient station air.
non_diegetic_music: Sparse acoustic piano playing isolated, slow-tempo chords in the mid-register, supported underneath by a sustained, low-register cello bow with a flat dynamic contour.

左脸受光，笔杆在桌上的影子向右延伸。

原始 prompt
夜间书房，固定中景。一盏台灯摆在桌面左边，女子在桌前写字，右边窗帘合拢，身后是米色墙。暖色主光来自左侧台灯，她的左脸受光，笔杆的影子向桌面右侧延伸。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, the camera holds a static shot in a medium framing inside a quiet nighttime study. Seated slightly to the right of center behind a dark walnut desk is a woman in her late twenties with dark hair gathered into a loose low ponytail, wearing a heather-gray knit cardigan over a soft white inner shirt. To the left side of the desk, an angled brass desk lamp emits a focused, warm golden light that serves as the dominant key source, casting bright illumination across the left side of her face, temple, and hand while leaving her right cheek and shoulder in soft shadow. In the background, a smooth beige wall spans the room, while on the right side of the frame, heavy charcoal-gray fabric curtains remain completely drawn shut over the window. An open cream-colored paper notebook rests on the wooden surface before her, where the distinct, elongated shadow of her dark fountain pen stretches diagonally toward the right across the open pages and polished wood grain. The woman glides the pen steadily across the page, forming neat lines of text with concentrated focus. Halfway through, she briefly pauses her hand, lifting her gaze slightly with a quiet blink of contemplation, before subtly adjusting her grip on the pen barrel, relaxing her shoulders, and continuing her steady, deliberate writing across the paper.
overall_soundscape: The distinct, crisp scratching sound of a metal fountain pen nib etching across textured paper is dominant in the foreground, accompanied by the faint rustle of her knit sleeve brushing against the desk. A subtle, low electrical hum from the incandescent desk lamp persists beneath the room tone, blending into an extremely quiet, muted nighttime indoor silence.
